narrative.overview: A navy-to-RVAP-blue opening field introduces the program, while white and pale-blue reading surfaces carry the technical detail. Official Microsoft icons, compact cards, and restrained blue-tinted depth make the 15-session path easy to scan without turning it into a dashboard. The full source ledger lives on its own page so it does not interrupt the program path.
keyCharacteristics: RVAS navy and blue visual identity

rules.name: The Navy Field Rule
rules.body: Navy carries the program promise and operational caveats. Ordinary reading sections stay light.

rules.name: The Semantic Phase Rule
rules.body: Blue means foundation, teal means assurance, and purple means operations.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Display type makes the argument, body type explains it, and mono type carries coordinates.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Routine records use low blue-tinted depth. Strong lift is reserved for focal or open surfaces.

rules.name: The Program Owns Content Rule
rules.body: The RVAS repository supplies appearance only. PRODUCT.md and the session manifests own public claims and curriculum structure.

dos: Use the exact RVAP logo assets and official Microsoft product icons in site/assets.
Keep public content aligned with PRODUCT.md and trace session claims to their manifests and dated sources.
Use navy for the strongest fields and pale blue to separate long reading sections.
Preserve the blue, teal, and purple phase mapping.
Keep dense records compact, responsive, and keyboard accessible.
donts: Do not copy the S0-S12 curriculum or claims from the visual-reference repository.
Do not restore the former warm-paper, vermilion, and square-ledger design.
Do not substitute generic cloud illustrations for official product icons.
Do not use mono type for ordinary prose.
Do not add customer proof or product promises that are absent from the research.
